name: TM
recent: 近期公告主要是 EPF 与 KWAP 的大股东持股变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面包括 TM 80 周年庆活动、Khantan Baru 问题处理、电缆盗窃案，以及柔佛数据中心发展相关报道。
notable: EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
TM 在太平举办 80 周年 Heritage Run，约 3,200 人参与。
MBI 与 Telekom Malaysia 就 Khantan Baru 问题采取行动。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动申报频繁，显示大股东持仓持续调整。
有 17 人因 ECRL 及 Telekom Malaysia 电缆盗窃案被捕。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 2,960.4 million，环比增长 0.9%，同比增长 6.8%；净利为 MYR 365.5 million，环比增长 13.7%，同比下降 9.3%；净利率为 12.3%，高于上一季度的 11.0%。

events.what_en: Deadline for the quarter ending Sep (Bursa rule)

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly substantial shareholder changes by EPF and KWAP, with no major corporate exercises. News included TM's 80th anniversary event, resolution of issues in Khantan Baru, cable theft arrests, and Johor data centre development coverage.
notable_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices between October and November.
TM held its 80th anniversary Heritage Run in Taiping with about 3,200 participants.
MBI and Telekom Malaysia took action to resolve issues in Khantan Baru.
risks_en: Frequent EPF and KWAP shareholding change filings indicate ongoing adjustments by substantial shareholders.
17 people were arrested over ECRL and Telekom Malaysia cable thefts.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,960.4 million, up 0.9% QoQ and 6.8% YoY; net income was MYR 365.5 million, up 13.7% QoQ but down 9.3% YoY; net margin was 12.3% versus 11.0% in the prior quarter.
